title: Bauden et al. 2026, Formation and Characterization of TCO SnO2:Ta Grown at Low Deposition Temperature (pss b)
notes: Six films in an O2-flow series (12, 60, 80, 100, 120, 150 sccm); only 100 sccm is characterised in depth.
Two rectangular targets (pure Sn and Sn/Ta 95:5 wt.%) are co-sputtered; target size 40 × 10 cm is not a scalar.
Sputter power 1000 W is stated as 'typical' for both magnetrons.
The SnO2:Ta (1.25 at.% Ta) film grown at 570 °C is from previous work (XPS reference), not a sample of this paper.
Table 1 lists literature samples; they are not samples of this paper.
Deposition time is not stated (only a rate of ~1 µm/h).
